theme: A quiet travel day, pointed south.
greeting: You're on the road south, Dan — a night in Fredericksburg, then the Coffee Pot cottage in St. Pete tomorrow. Nothing's on the calendar, so the open stretch is yours; the booking items below have waited long enough.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The p1 rental has sat since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest inventory in that market — book refundable now and adjust the dates later.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break plan
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sept 30 and the Oct 15 book-by has passed. Pick domestic or international and get the three-week trip for six onto the calendar before holiday inventory thins further.
